Appraiser
Access property valuation details through the Parcel Search tool. Certified appraisers, lenders, and agents can also request sales data access.
Brown County Genealogy
Genealogy resources including historical records, cemetery listings, and archival information to assist with family history research in Brown County.
County Attorney
Legal services and representation for Brown County, including prosecution of criminal cases, legal counsel to county departments, and enforcement of county regulations.
County Clerk
Official duties of the Brown County Clerk, including election management, records maintenance, budget oversight, and support for the County Commission.
County Commissioners
Brown County has three commission districts. District 1 includes Hiawatha City Wards 2 and 3. District 3 includes Hiawatha City Wards 1 and 4.
District Court
Learn more about District Court on this page.
Emergency Management
Emergency Management involves preparing for, responding to, and recovering from disasters to protect lives, property, and the environment.
Extension Office
Learn more about Extension Office on this page.
Health Department
Learn more about Health Department on this page.
Household Hazardous Waste
Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) includes items like paints, cleaners, batteries, and pesticides that can harm health or the environment if not disposed of properly.
Information Technology
Technology has become a big part of our lives, both personally and in the work environment.
Noxious Weed
Cost share on chemicals used on noxious weeds only.
Register of Deeds
Official public office responsible for recording, maintaining, and safeguarding property records and land-related documents.
Road and Bridge
Brown County is a County Township Road System. There are 35 County Township Road Systems in the State of Kansas.
Services for the Elderly
Information and resources supporting the well-being, independence, and care of senior citizens in the community.
Sheriff
Visit the Sheriff on this page.
Solid Waste / Landfill
Responsible for waste disposal, recycling services, and maintaining a safe, environmentally compliant landfill for the community.
Treasurer
The mission of the treasurer is to keep accurate accounting records of all transactions made by the county and provide any information needed by individuals and all departments.
